title: Registry: memo kinds
description: registry/memos.json in the kingdom (copied from @elvaria/registry-default on init; `elvaria migrate` copies it into a kingdom made before PS-02). Each kind of memo (letter) a character may write in the Memos section of its handover letter, and where the Steward routes it (ADR 0024). Default registry: proposal (work outside the quest) to the Chancellor; objection (the assignee contests the verdict that sent its run back) to a second judge, PS-22; advisory and request come with PS-09 and PS-10.
$comment: Generated by `pnpm schemas` from the zod source in packages/domain/src/schema (ADR 0003): change the zod source, never this file. Not expressible here: ids are unique (loader). Display names live here for the CLI; the UI takes them through i18n.

route.description: Where a memo of this kind goes.

description.description: When a character writes this kind; the assignee prompt does not list it, the CLI and docs do.

memos.description: Work found outside the quest's scope: written down for the Chancellor instead of done in place.
